label: One and the same actual concrete root at w exists at every world accessible from w…, from whole
meaning: Import NecessaryFirstBeing.necessaryFirstPureAct from its unchanged seven explicit inputs and compose the modular attributesFromFirst theorem. A composite supplies a distinct component whose simple priority contradicts firstness. A component-of-anything status contradicts the existing no-component-is-first-being premise, giving RemoteFromAll of that same witness. Retain actual concrete rootness, modal necessity and no potency. The three structural premises remain independently open; no maximum/convergence, positive act, uniqueness or God premise is inferred.

strong_version_needed.ee4ab504-c8fe-59bc-bc96-7cbeefed6410: The proof applies excluded middle to propositions outside LocalLogic's scope, e.g. `m.ontic.ExistsAt v x` (in contingentRootOfNonnecessary); `∃ v, m.ontic.frame.access w v ∧ ¬m.ontic.ExistsAt v x` (in contingentRootOfNonnecessary). LocalLogic (ca432e24) decides only whether an actual bearer is identical with a GOD_4 candidate, and gives double-negation elimination for that candidate's esse–essence identity.
